QuestInfo.name: Kyrin of the Nautilus
QuestInfo.0: You crash landed in Maple World. What kind of place is this?
QuestInfo.1: With Burke's betrayal, you lost the core and ended up living a new life on Maple World. Captain Kyrin, the woman who saved you, called this place the Nautilus. Go see her to get some help in getting adjusted to life here. Kyrin is at #m120000101#.
QuestInfo.2: With Kyrin's help, you've begun a new life on this strange world. Maybe you should keep a low profile until you learn to fit in.

0.0: A letter came to the Nautilus addressed to you...

yes.0: You'll have to hoist your own sails if you want to get the respect of the crew.
yes.1: And you're not going to get anywhere without my say so. Show me you can take orders and I'll let you start pulling your own weight around here.

no.0: You'll need my help to get adjusted to Maple World.

1.0: You'll have to hoist your own sails if you want to get the respect of the crew.
1.1: And you're not going to get ANYWHERE without my help, so I hope you don't mind taking orders.

yes.0: You ready to start pulling your weight around here?
